scientific_integrity: All universal statements have explicit proofs. Finite exhaustive checker corroborates small cases but is not an infinite proof. Same-model review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only all-matchings covered-vertex concepts on finite bipartite simple graphs; not perfect/maximum-only matching families, edge-incidence concepts, or arbitrary graphs. Nonpurity examples give a lower bound on facet-size gaps, not a complete facet spectrum. Historical priority may be affected by equivalent results under transversal-matching terminology.
title: Shattering by matching-covered vertices in bipartite graphs
